blocks.text: Pakistan ke paas kai kache maal hain jo is ki kimiyai sanaton ke liye ahem hain; kisi sanat ka kacha maal (feedstock) us ki jagah aur maashi kamyabi tay karta hai. Hawa khaad ke liye nitrogen aur steel sazi ke liye oxygen deti hai. Pani solvent, thanda karne wale maddah aur hydrogen ke zariye ke taur par use hota hai. Koyla, tel aur qudrati gas jaise fossil fuels 90% organic kimiyai maddon ke liye darkaar hydrocarbons dete hain.

items: Qudrati gas: methane (CH4) ka bara zariya, khaad (urea) aur petrochemicals banane mein; yeh fuel bhi hai aur hydrogen ka zariya bhi.

Sendha namak (Khewra ki kaanein): Khewra duniya ke sab se bare namak ke zakhiron mein se hai; yeh sodium chloride (NaCl) ka zariya hai, jo soda ash (Na2CO3), caustic soda (NaOH) aur chlorine ka kacha maal hai.
Chuna-pathar (limestone): Salt Range aur Sindh mein bohat wafir; cement ki sanat ke liye calcium carbonate (CaCO3) ka zariya.
Gypsum: cement ki sanat aur plaster banane mein; calcium aur sulphur ka zariya aur mitti behtar karne wala maddah bhi.
Chromite: Muslim Bagh mein milta; stainless steel aur rang (pigments) banane mein.
Kacha tel: saaf kar ke mukhtalif fuels aur petrochemicals banaye jate.
Sulphur: sulphuric acid (H2SO4) banane mein, jo aik kaleedi sanati kimiyai maddah hai.

blocks.alt: Saat qatarein, har aik mein kache maal ka neela dabba teer se products ke sabz dabbe se jura: qudrati gas (zyada tar methane) se urea, petrochemicals, fuel aur hydrogen; Khewra ka namak (NaCl) se soda ash, caustic soda aur chlorine; chuna-pathar (CaCO3) se cement; gypsum se cement, plaster aur mitti ki behtari; Muslim Bagh ka chromite se stainless steel aur rang; kacha tel se fuels aur petrochemicals; sulphur se sulphuric acid. Oopar ki lakeer hawa (N2, O2) aur pani batati.

blocks.long_description: Har maqami kacha maal aik ya zyada sanaton ko chalata hai; maqami maal ka istemal lagat aur dar-aamad kam karta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Pakistan ke paas wafir qudrati gas hai, jo urea (NH2CONH2) banane ka bara kacha maal hai. Kacha maal maqami taur par dastyab hone se paidawari lagat kam hai, jis se khaad kisanon ke liye sasti hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Khewra ka kaun sa kacha maal soda ash aur caustic soda banane mein use hota hai?

items: Hawa (N2, O2), pani, fossil fuels (90% organic maddey).
Qudrati gas, Khewra ka namak, chuna-pathar, gypsum, Muslim Bagh chromite, kacha tel, sulphur.
